description: Rebuild the ABOUT (src/app/about-us/page.tsx) and CONTACT (src/app/contact-us/page.tsx) pages to match the prototype, and finalize copy/content adaptation + the drop-in-real-art asset checklist. About: hero + who-we-are split + pastel pill tags + dark principles band + why-choose-us pastel cards + founder quote. Contact: hero + three contact-method cards (inline SVG icons) + enquiry form (reusing ContactForm.tsx logic). Depends on FEAT-001; shares patterns with FEAT-002/003. This feature also fixes the About em-dash copy so check:copy stays clean and writes the final asset-substitution checklist.
steps: ABOUT hero: eyebrow 'What we are', h1 (Space Grotesk) 'Technology partners, ' + <em accent> 'not just developers.', sub 'We bridge complex technical possibilities and real business outcomes through AI-first thinking and accountable delivery.'

ABOUT who-we-are split: image column (reuse an existing asset - /krupal-chaudhary.jpg or an inline-SVG/gradient placeholder, NOT the missing about.webp) radius 18 | text column: eyebrow 'Who we are', h2 'Digital transformation architects.', p 'At DEMAze Technologies, we are a passionate team of 35+ technologists, innovators, and strategic thinkers who believe in the power of AI to reshape businesses, bridging complex technical possibilities with real outcomes.' CRITICAL: the prototype copy contains an em dash ('businesses -- bridging'); REPLACE it with a comma/hyphen restructure as shown so check:copy passes. Source this from src/content/about.ts (whoWeAre) - update whoWeAre copy if needed and keep it em-dash-free.

ABOUT pastel pill tags: a row of pill tags with rotating pastel backgrounds (oklch 305/145/220/88): 'AI-First Innovation', 'Scalable Solutions', 'Digital Transformation', 'Future-Ready Architecture', 'Automation Excellence', 'Strategic Partnership'. Source from src/content/about.ts whatWeAreTags (first 6).

ABOUT dark principles band: background var(--color-ink) color var(--color-page), eyebrow 'What drives us', h2 'Principles behind the work.' 4 principles (same four as home's Why Choose Us, shorter copy): reuse src/content/about.ts whatDrivesUs titles with concise descriptions. Hyphens NOT em dashes.

ABOUT why-choose-us: h2 'Clarity at every level.' 3 pastel cards: 'Real-Time Analytics', 'AI-Driven Growth', 'Live Collaboration' (source from about.ts whyChooseUsAbout; adapt the third title to 'Live Collaboration' or keep 'Sync in Real Time' - match the prototype label 'Live Collaboration').

ABOUT founder quote card: pastel-gold (oklch 0.96 0.06 88) background card with the SAME quote as home ('Through the strategic use of your vision and data, we design AI solutions that make your brand stand out and drive revenue growth, leading execution with focus and accountability.'), founder name Krupal Chaudhary / Founder & CEO, portrait /krupal-chaudhary.jpg.

CONTACT hero: eyebrow 'Contact', h1 'Reach us ' + <em accent> 'at any time.', sub 'Tell us what you are building, improving, or trying to understand. We will start with the useful questions.' (avoid apostrophe/em-dash issues; use plain ASCII or the site's existing typographic apostrophe convention consistently).

CONTACT split (0.9fr/1.1fr): LEFT three contact-method <a> cards, each with an inline SVG icon (envelope / calendar / map-pin) + a small label + a strong value: 'Email us' / contact@demazetech.com (mailto:, from site.email); 'Prefer a conversation?' / 'Send a meeting request' (href to the form anchor #enquiry); 'Office location' / the studio address (google maps link from site.mapsHref). RIGHT a <form id="enquiry"> border radius 18 bg #fff padding 26: reuse ContactForm.tsx behavior (draft/mailto/copy logic) but restyle to the prototype: 2-col name+email row, company input, message textarea, 'Send message' pink submit. Keep the no-JS mailto fallback and existing validation. Do NOT introduce a real submission endpoint. Inputs: padding 12px 14px, border 1px var(--color-line), radius 8, 14px.

CONTACT: ensure the ContactForm styling classes referenced exist (either extend StudioPages.css usage or add prototype form CSS to globals.css). Keep the founder aside/quote if convenient but match the prototype's three-card + form layout as the primary structure.

Adapt content files as needed (about.ts, editorial.ts, industries.ts, services.ts) so all redesigned pages source copy from src/content where practical and remain check:copy-clean. Do a final pass: run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node scripts/check-copy.mjs src` and fix any em-dash findings.

Write the final asset drop-in checklist to .agents/tasks/task-fullsite-redesign/asset-checklist.md mapping EVERY prototype filename to its substitute: demaze-robot-studio.mp4 -> /hero-transform.mp4; demaze-robot-studio-poster.webp -> css gradient fallback (no poster); demaze-logo.png -> exists (/demaze-logo.png); tech-langchain/python/tensorflow/openai/huggingface/pinecone/kafka/elastic.png -> text wordmark placeholders; project-car/investigation/luxury/sukoon/marketplace/grocery/cma/recruitment.webp -> pastel CSS-gradient placeholder tiles; service-ai/web/commerce/cloud.(webp/png) -> inline-SVG/gradient placeholders; about.webp -> /krupal-chaudhary.jpg or gradient placeholder; founder.webp -> /krupal-chaudhary.jpg; footer.png -> /demaze-logo.png or inline mark. For each, note the file+line where a real asset would drop in.
acceptance_criteria: src/app/about-us/page.tsx renders the prototype hero, who-we-are split (em-dash-free copy), pastel pill tags, dark principles band, why-choose-us pastel cards, and founder quote card, sourcing copy from src/content/about.ts.

src/app/contact-us/page.tsx renders the prototype hero, three inline-SVG contact-method cards (email mailto, meeting-request anchor, maps link), and a styled #enquiry form reusing ContactForm.tsx behavior with the no-JS mailto fallback intact.
No /Image src points to a nonexistent asset (about.webp/founder.webp substituted); decorative visuals aria-hidden.
Headings use Space Grotesk, body uses DM Sans, colors use oklch tokens; pages collapse responsively at <=820px.
The About who-we-are paragraph and all new copy are free of em dashes and encoded equivalents.
.agents/tasks/task-fullsite-redesign/asset-checklist.md exists and maps every prototype filename to its substitute with drop-in locations.
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && node scripts/check-copy.mjs src (must pass across the whole redesign)
Read both page files; confirm ContactForm still handles submit->draft->mailto and the noscript fallback, and no missing-asset srcs.
grep -R 'about\.webp\|founder\.webp' src/ returns no src usages.
Confirm asset-checklist.md covers every prototype filename listed in the briefing.
If deps install: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run format:check
